newsitem.title: USA: SubMicron Systems in Reg D note agreement.
newsitem.headline: SubMicron Systems in Reg D note agreement.

text.p: SubMicron Systems Corp Monday said it agreed with the current Reg D noteholders to retire substantially all of the outstanding $19 million, nine percent subordinated convertible notes due in December of 1997. In addition, detachable warrants related to the retired notes will also be eliminated.
The agreement is subject to final documentation.

Terms call for outstanding notes and warrants to be replaced with approximately $10 million of preferred stock convertible into common shares at $3.70 per share and $9 million of eight-percent, five-year notes also convertible into common shares at $3.70 per share. These notes include provisions for redemption and mandatory conversion under certain circumstances and will be presented for approval to the company's stockholders in May as may be required by Nasdaq regulations.
